title: tanghinia odollam
intro: Tanghinia odollam, commonly known as "Ylang-Ylang", is a flowering evergreen tree native to Madagascar. The plant is renowned for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote better sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Tanghinia odollam are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, that work together to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Additionally, the essential oils extracted from the plant have been used in traditional medicine for their calming and soothing effects, making it a popular ingredient in perfumes and aromatherapy products.
